decision.title: WebAssembly slice: preopens and the first size budget (packet )

item.p: Preopens: tools/run-wasi.mjs preopens the working directory as "." (as before) and the source tree, the parent of tools/, under its own absolute path. Tests that find files from __FILE__ (xml_conformance: <root>/tests/../third_party/xmlconf) now run under WASI instead of "skipped": 601/175/948, as native. The whole tree, not only third_party/, because wasi-libc picks a preopen by path prefix without resolving "..". qt4/slice already ran in the repository root; 198/198 pass under wasm. The CLI's cli/xpath_* goldens (19) already run under WASI, so no new e2e tests.

Sizes (module stripped with llvm-strip; gzip -9): sxml CLI 1,534,842 bytes raw, 1,213,261 stripped, 358,020 gzip (code 808 KB, data 401 KB of which 374 KB read-only: parse tables); sxml-qt4 1,588,530 / 1,264,250 / 376,528. Archives: libsxml.a 947,910; tree-sitter 189,342; mpdecimal 153,762; grammars xml 93,664, xpath 340,646. Native release sxml stripped: 1,743,480 (x86-64).
Time (3 runs, 4 cores): the slice, sxml-qt4 run tests/qt4/torture-slice.txt: native release 0.89-1.00 s, wasm 1.88-1.92 s (about 2x; Node start-up 0.05 s); xml_conformance 0.11 s native, 0.26 s wasm.

Budget (PLAN.md risks): the stripped sxml CLI module stays under 1.5 MB and 450 KB gzipped until a decision raises it; a change that adds more than 50 KB stripped logs the growth (as 1.2 did). Not yet checked by CI: that needs a size test in CMake or ci.yml (not this packet's files).
